headline: Clinton order directs all federal executive agencies to take steps that help make sure child support gets paid.
what_it_does: This executive order tells every executive branch agency to take certain actions to help with the payment of child support. No official summary was provided, so the exact steps are not described here. Based on the title, it focuses on the federal government's own role in helping child support reach the families owed it.

who_it_affects.how: They are required to take actions that help child support get paid.

who_it_affects.group: Parents and children who are owed child support
who_it_affects.how: They may benefit if federal agencies help make sure support payments are made.
Federal agencies' actions may affect how their child support payments are handled or collected.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 27, 1995; effective date not stated in the source material.
